rationale: The 81,212 reduce line confirmed on two 1H closes and price wicked to 80,514.5 with long liquidations still printing and longs crowded (ratio 2.11). Overnight gap is 6.5h on a weekend, so trim a quarter of the spot book and hold the cash; futures stay flat with no edge for leverage.

message.text: Spot trimmed 25% into the 80.5-80.7k flush. Bearish below 80,514.5 (targets 79,775 then 78.3k); reclaim of 81,850 on 1H would neutralize it. Reload near 79.8k or on a 82.2k reclaim.

lesson.pattern: Midday spot DCA inside a range-bear box with a reduce line only 400 points below
lesson.insight: When the reduce line is within one ATR of price and 1H EMAs are all overhead, a small DCA gets stopped by the very line the report names; wait for the line to hold before adding.
